verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents table versioning (snapshots, audit trails), branching to fork isolated writable lines for experiments, and explicit guidance on using branches to isolate agent-driven experiments and promote winners—covering version/rollback of automation pipelines built on it. However 'review' tooling (diffing, approval workflows) is only implied via 'audit trails' with no concrete detail, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of these features working as described. Missing for 10: detailed review/diff UI or workflow, independent user validation of branching/versioning in practice, and clearer tie to 'automations' beyond data/table state.
